race.description: Tobin Brothers Celebrating Lives Mdn Plate
race.comment: LUNA VEGA (8) has the strongest exposed profile, having run second here in the Mornington Sires, beaten a neck by The Speed Machine, after earlier finishing sixth in the Listed Merson Cooper Stakes at Caulfield when beaten only two and a half lengths. She resumes off two trial wins and rates highest on resumption. JOHNNY TIGHTLIPS (1) has just found one better in all three starts, sent out shorter in the market each time. Now with the Matt Laurie yard on his new home track, he should go well despite a wide gate. ROYAL TEA (9) was forced wide on debut before closing into second at this track as favourite, and that race experience keeps her firmly in the winning mix. IDMISTON (11) was plain on debut at Canterbury but pulled up with excuses and the latest Cranbourne trial for the Freedman yard suggest she'll be a sharp improver.
